_note: Endpoint manifest generated by A2 from static analysis of the wallet's JS chunks. The wallet uses JSON-RPC over POST to /api/rpc (devnet) and /api-mainnet/rpc (mainnet). Each method listed here becomes a handler in the single RPC dispatch route.

endpoints.name: chain_info
endpoints.responseEnvelope: { chain_id: string, block_height: number, block_hash: string, genesis_time: string, native_asset: { symbol: string, decimals: number } }
endpoints.notes: Called on every page load + polling interval to show chain status and connectivity.

endpoints.name: validator_set
endpoints.responseEnvelope: { validators: { address: string, voting_power: number, moniker: string }[] }
endpoints.notes: Polled alongside chain_info to display validator count.

endpoints.name: account_get
endpoints.responseEnvelope: { address: string, balance: string, nonce: number, assets: Record<string, string> }
endpoints.notes: Core account query. Called before every send/swap to get current nonce. Returns balance in microWSK and per-asset balances.

endpoints.name: transaction_status
endpoints.notes: Polled every 2.5s after a transfer is broadcast to track confirmation.

endpoints.name: transaction_broadcast
endpoints.notes: Submits a signed native WSK transfer. Returns a tx hash for status polling.

endpoints.name: token_list
endpoints.responseEnvelope: { tokens: { token_id: string, name: string, symbol: string, decimals: number, display_name: string }[] }
endpoints.notes: Lists all native tokens on the chain. Used to populate the watched-tokens panel.

endpoints.name: token_evm_address
endpoints.responseEnvelope: { token_id: string, evm_address: string, symbol: string, decimals: number, image: string }
endpoints.notes: Derives the deterministic EVM address for a native token. Used for MetaMask import and token-detail sheet.

endpoints.name: token_operation_status
endpoints.notes: Polled every 2.5s after a token create/transfer to track confirmation.

endpoints.name: token_operation_prepare
endpoints.notes: Returns canonical signing bytes for a token operation. The wallet signs these locally.

endpoints.name: token_operation_broadcast
endpoints.notes: Submits a signed token create/transfer/mint/burn. Returns operation_id and token_id.

endpoints.name: mna_quote
endpoints.responseEnvelope: { amount_usdc: string, amount_mna: string, rate: string }
endpoints.notes: Gets a reserve swap quote: USDC to WSK conversion at the fixed rate.

endpoints.name: mna_swap_status
endpoints.notes: Polled after a reserve swap broadcast to track confirmation.

endpoints.name: mna_swap_prepare
endpoints.notes: Returns signing bytes for a USDC-WSK reserve swap.

endpoints.name: mna_swap_broadcast
endpoints.notes: Submits a signed reserve swap.

endpoints.name: mna_reserve_status
endpoints.notes: Returns the fixed USDC-WSK conversion rate and whether the reserve is collateralized.

endpoints.name: asset_list
endpoints.responseEnvelope: { assets: { id: string, symbol: string, display_name: string, name: string, enabled: boolean, decimals: number, token_id?: string }[] }
endpoints.notes: Returns all protocol-level assets (native WSK, wrapped USDC lanes, native tokens). Polled on load.

endpoints.name: bridge_status
endpoints.responseEnvelope: { ethereum: { network: string, connected: boolean }, solana: { network: string, mode: string, connected: boolean } }
endpoints.notes: Shows the status of each bridge lane (Ethereum, Solana).

endpoints.name: auth_challenge
endpoints.notes: Issues a one-time challenge message for wallet ownership proof. The wallet signs it locally.

endpoints.name: auth_verify
endpoints.notes: Verifies a signed challenge and returns a session token.

endpoints.name: devnet_faucet
endpoints.notes: Devnet only. Credits test WSK to an address. Returns the faucet tx hash.

endpoints.name: sol_mna_quote
endpoints.notes: Oracle quote for SOL to WSK conversion via the Solana bridge lane.

endpoints.name: healthz
endpoints.notes: Simple health check. Original at rpc-worldstreet.intertrain.online/healthz.

endpoints.name: metrics
endpoints.notes: Prometheus metrics endpoint. Original at rpc-worldstreet.intertrain.online/metrics.
